extension.description: Language support for CS2 Panorama layouts and styles
panorama.contentRoots.description: Explicit content roots for resolving s2r://. Leave empty to auto-detect: first the nearest ancestor containing both layout/ and styles/, then verified against the files that actually exist
panorama.customHudLayout.include.descrip: Layouts matching these globs get completions from the CustomHudLayout whitelist (only Panel/Label/Image/Button)
Level for CustomHudLayout strict-mode whitelist violations: panels or attributes outside the four-panel whitelist, <scripts>, inline style, {d:}/{g:}/{t:} bindings and so on
panorama.diagnostics.duplicateId.descrip: Level for a duplicated id within one scope (each <snippet> is its own scope)
panorama.diagnostics.structure.descripti: Level for VXML structural problems: unknown tags, rootOnly panels in a nested position, an id on the root panel, <styles>/<scripts>/<snippets> ordering, unclosed tags
panorama.diagnostics.unknownClass.descri: Level for a class name referenced by class= that has no VCSS definition in the workspace. The engine stylesheets are not part of the workspace, so this tops out at warning
panorama.diagnostics.unknownProperty.des: Level for a property or value that is not in the known list. The list comes from documentation and the corpus and is proven incomplete, so this tops out at warning
panorama.diagnostics.unresolvedReference: Level for an @define constant or @keyframes reference whose definition cannot be resolved
panorama.diagnostics.webOnlySyntax.descr: Level for Web-only CSS constructs: display/float/flex, position keywords, vw/vh/em/rem, :: pseudo-elements, visibility: hidden, -- custom properties, unquoted @keyframes names, color-first box-shadow, background-size: clip_then_cover
panorama.index.enabled.description: When off, cross-file features (cross-file class completion, go to definition, find references) fall back to single-file behaviour
panorama.index.exclude.description: Extra globs to exclude while indexing, appended after the built-in node_modules exclusion
panorama.mcp.enable.title: Enable MCP for AI Assistants
panorama.mcp.enabled.description: Run the embedded MCP server (a localhost daemon shared by every window) so AI assistants such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and the VS Code agent can validate Panorama files and query panel/property data. The daemon exits on its own when no window and no client has used it for 90 seconds
panorama.mcp.port.description: Port of the MCP daemon on 127.0.0.1. One daemon serves every workspace; clients configure http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp
